post.caption:
Autocorrect, maps routing round traffic that has not happened yet, spam filtering, recommendations, bank fraud detection, and the heavy computational photography inside every phone photo. All of it is machine learning, none of it announced itself, and none of it is new. AI stopped being a topic and became infrastructure. The chatbots everyone argues about are a small and recent slice of what you already rely on daily.
